Gain cannot be attributed to the layerwise loss: the loss is DepthFL's, the KL term and the L-1 classifier ensemble readout are not ablated, and baseline readout is unstated

notes: (1) The arXiv API returned HTTP 429/503 repeatedly; a single failing call made related_search.py hang for minutes, and C3, the benchmark query and the baseline scout were never run; the skill does not say how many retries are acceptable. `benchmarks` did not recognise MNIST/Fashion-MNIST, so no baseline scout was possible. (2) The skill orders the literature check after Phase 1 for independence, but in a single context the reviewers have already read the paper, and the search results then shape the Domain addendum; independence is only nominal and is disclosed in review.md. (3) The DA criterion-3 decision table row 2 says the main claim must hold 'at every other value in the sweep'; here it holds in 59 of 60 alternative cells (one Alternating cell fails), and the skill does not say how to treat a single exception; I treated it as row 2 (MAJOR). (4) The skill's venue text says ICLR label '6' in one place and the script prints '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})'; I reported the script's label. (5) For R3, Overall 4 with pool position 66 produced a script pool band of 55-61 that the R3 composite (62.6) slightly exceeds, without a warning; this is allowed but slightly confusing against the 'pool >= 65 for Overall 4' guidance. (6) Table 7 and Algorithm 1/2 are garbled in extraction, so a few details were treated as unverifiable. (7) Two points rely on my own recollection of dataset sizes (binary test splits of ~2,000 images vs the stated 3000) and were kept as questions, not errors, because the paper itself cannot confirm them; the skill's precision rules cover this only implicitly. (8) The five reviewers were run sequentially in one model context, as the skill permits; reports were kept separate but are not truly independent.
